name: Emily Suzura
source:
Just like a midnight candle, Emily burns with a fiery passion. She is confident and prideful with her own paintings and she looks at Yukari as a rival. Emily is also a close childhood friend of Saari despite their differences. 
Although Emily never met Kazu before, she does hold a slight sense of suspicion towards him due to his odd behavior.
